title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Model Validation Protocols for Machine Learning in Small Molecule Drug Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning (ML) models for molecular property prediction are increasingly deployed in drug discovery, yet their adoption in real-world scenarios requires an understanding of the conditions in which a model succeeds or fails. While standardized benchmarks are powerful instruments to measure and unlock progress in ML research, they should not be blindly treated as the end goal. Especially static and retrospective benchmarks, in which no true unknown test set is employed, limit our ability to robustly validate a model's performance. Building on the collective expertise of a cross-industry consortium, we present a model validation framework consisting of five recommendations that would enable the community to move beyond aggregate metrics toward understanding where and why molecular property prediction models fail. We connect evaluation choices to real-world applications and case studies encountered in pharmaceutical research. The framework proposes splitting strategies that mimic realistic distribution shifts and expose common failure modes. We apply the recommended framework to a recently released dataset of absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) properties. Across two complementary model algorithms, our case studies reveal four distinct failure modes (extrapolation, interpolation, representation, and evaluation), showing that model errors arise not only from distribution shift but also from limitations in molecular representations. Our results show that commonly used evaluation protocols can significantly overestimate performance and may not detect important model failure modes. All software and data are released via https://github.com/srijitseal/polaris.
items.summary_zh: 提出小分子药物发现中机器学习模型的五项验证建议，并在 ADME 数据集与两类模型上展示现行评估方案可能高估性能、遗漏关键失效模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把基准评测与制药研发中的分布漂移、分子表示和应用场景联系起来，有助于提高性质预测结果的可用性。证据主要来自一个 ADME 数据集和两种算法，跨任务、跨实验流程的普适性仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 用于分子性质预测的机器学习（ML）模型正日益部署于药物发现中，但要在真实场景采用这些模型，需要理解模型成功或失败的条件。标准化基准是衡量和推动 ML 研究进展的有力工具，却不应被盲目视为最终目标。尤其是未采用真正未知测试集的静态和回顾性基准，限制了我们稳健验证模型性能的能力。基于一个跨行业联盟的集体专长，我们提出由五项建议组成的模型验证框架，使研究界能够超越汇总指标，理解分子性质预测模型在何处以及为何失效。我们将评估选择与制药研究中遇到的真实应用和案例研究联系起来。该框架提出了模拟真实分布漂移并暴露常见失效模式的数据划分策略。我们将建议框架应用于一个近期发布的吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）性质数据集。在两种互补的模型算法中，案例研究揭示了四种不同的失效模式（外推、插值、表示和评估），表明模型误差不仅源于分布漂移，也来自分子表示的局限。结果显示，常用评估方案可能显著高估性能，并可能无法发现重要的模型失效模式。全部软件和数据已通过 https://github.com/srijitseal/polaris 发布。

items.title: First-Principles Atomistic Structure and Dynamics of Polyethylene During High-Pressure Radical Polymerization via Machine Learning Force Fields
items.abstract_or_text: Polyethylene (PE) is one of the most commonly used synthetic polymers. While the synthesis and processing protocols for PE are well established, precise experimental assignment of microscopic structures at atomistic resolution (i.e., the position of each atom) remains largely limited to highly crystalline systems. This gap is often addressed via computer simulations using empirical interatomic potentials, which use approximate but efficient descriptions of interatomic interactions to reach the length and time scales needed to describe macromolecules. These empirical potentials typically perform well for bulk and/or collective properties but face challenges with chemical realism for complex systems, e.g., during reactive processes. In this work, we address this challenge by combining the computational efficiency of a deep potential (DP) machine-learning force field and the chemical realism of first-principles van der Waals (vdW) corrected hybrid density functional theory (DFT) enabled by a SeA high-throughput framework. Using this approach, we study the structure and dynamics of PE oligomers and polymers in an ethylene solvent under common high-pressure (supercritical) radical polymerization conditions. We found that the local solvation environment of radical-containing PE oligomers converges for chain lengths greater than (n~6), suggesting extensibility of our oligomer-trained MLFF to significantly longer polymers. We then confirmed the extensibility of these models to long PE chains by characterizing the molecular weight scaling of single-chain structure and dynamics, which showed classic good solvent behavior. Our PE MLFF retained a consistent level of fidelity and stability across a wide range of thermodynamic state points and chain lengths, at full atomistic resolution, therefore paving the way towards first-principles-based polymer structure and property prediction.
items.summary_zh: 将深度势机器学习力场与含 vdW 校正的杂化 DFT 结合，模拟高压自由基聚合条件下聚乙烯低聚物和长链的原子级结构与动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究尝试以接近一性原理的精度扩展聚合物反应体系模拟，可服务于结构—性质预测。摘要未给出与实验测量的直接定量比对，且模型可迁移性仍须在更复杂反应条件下确认。
items.abstract_zh: 聚乙烯（PE）是最常用的合成聚合物之一。尽管 PE 的合成与加工方案已经很成熟，对微观结构进行原子级分辨率的精确实验归属，即确定每个原子的位置，仍在很大程度上局限于高度结晶的体系。计算机模拟通常采用经验原子间势来弥补这一缺口；此类势函数以近似但高效的原子间相互作用描述，达到表征大分子所需的长度和时间尺度。这些经验势通常能够较好描述体相和或集体性质，却在复杂体系的化学真实性方面面临挑战，例如反应过程。本文将深度势（DP）机器学习力场的计算效率与由 SeA 高通量框架实现的、经 van der Waals（vdW）校正的一性原理杂化密度泛函理论（DFT）的化学真实性相结合，以解决这一挑战。利用这一方法，我们研究了常见高压（超临界）自由基聚合条件下、乙烯溶剂中 PE 低聚物和聚合物的结构与动力学。我们发现，含自由基的 PE 低聚物的局部溶剂化环境在链长大于（n~6）时收敛，表明以低聚物训练的 MLFF 可扩展至显著更长的聚合物。随后，我们通过表征单链结构和动力学随分子量的变化，证实这些模型可扩展至长 PE 链；结果显示出经典的良溶剂行为。PE MLFF 在广泛的热力学状态点和链长范围内、以完整原子分辨率保持了一致的保真度和稳定性，因此为基于一性原理的聚合物结构与性质预测铺平了道路。
items.author_line: Bharatha K. Gunawardana, Teresa Shah, Bicha Azizova, Deepa Ranabhat, Yizhi Song, Akshath Shastri, Srinjoy Ghose, Thomas E. Gartner, Hsin-Yu Ko

items.title: RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.
items.summary_zh: 发布 16.1 亿参数、原生支持 10,240 nt 上下文的双向 RNA 基础模型 RIBOSPAN，并以其骨干开展全长 mRNA 生成、重设计和保留蛋白质的 CDS 优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 长转录本的单核苷酸建模与 mRNA 设计直接关联 RNA 药物和合成生物学；摘要报告多类表征评测中的领先结果。实际翻译效率、细胞表型及跨实验平台效应尚未在摘要中展开。
items.abstract_zh: 全长 RNA，尤其是信使 RNA，常常超过现有 RNA 基础模型预训练所用的上下文长度，限制了以单核苷酸分辨率对完整转录本进行建模。我们提出 RIBOSPAN：一个拥有 16.1 亿参数的双向 RNA 基础模型，原生预训练上下文长度最高为 10,240 nt。RIBOSPAN 结合稠密双向自注意力、单核苷酸标记化以及注意力隔离的序列打包，以实现对完整长 RNA 的高分辨率建模。我们通过核苷酸重建、受控长上下文表征基准以及冻结 RNA 类型表征分析来评估该模型。原生 10K 预训练在 10,240 个 token 上保持强大的重建能力；采用 40% 掩蔽的继续预训练在保留表征质量的同时，提高了严重损坏条件下的恢复能力。长上下文基准进一步表明，原生 10K 模型保持强上下文响应性和上下文特异的表征分离，同时使扰动诱导的表征变化高度局部化。推理时 YaRN 缩放恢复了短上下文模型直接外推时丢失的大部分上下文组织，但会导致显著更大的远端表征扩散。冻结表征评估进一步显示出最先进的 RNA 表征质量：RIBOSPAN 在多种 RNA 类型上取得最强的总体性能，并在长 RNA 上保持明显优势。基于同一骨干，我们开发了一个多维条件化的离散扩散框架，用于全长 mRNA 生成和重设计，其中包括用于保留蛋白质的 CDS 优化的同义密码子扩散。RIBOSPAN 因此为可迁移 RNA 表征学习和全转录本 mRNA 设计建立了强大的长上下文基础。
items.author_line: Ziyuan Wang, Bohao Tang, Fei Zhang, Shuo Han, Pengfei Liu

items.title: Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules
items.abstract_or_text: Despite recent advances in molecular foundation models, several limitations remain, such as chemically invalid augmentations, modality collapse, and incomplete representation of biochemical environments. To address these challenges, we present Mol-JEPA, a scalable framework for learning molecular world models. Rather than relying on suboptimal molecular perturbations, our model uses modality masking to exploit information from molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations and other drug discovery data. Across various benchmarks, we show that the representations learned by Mol-JEPA deliver strong performance, demonstrating the value of incorporating biochemical context through latent space prediction.
items.summary_zh: Mol-JEPA 以模态掩蔽学习分子表征，同时利用结构、细胞表型、结合亲和力、ADMET 和量子化学模拟等多模态药物发现数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其设计试图避免化学上无效的增强和单一模态塌缩，并将生化环境纳入表征学习。摘要只笼统报告多项基准性能，未列出具体数据构成、任务结果或外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管分子基础模型近期取得进展，仍存在若干局限，例如化学上无效的增强、模态塌缩以及对生化环境的不完整表征。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 Mol-JEPA，一个可扩展的分子世界模型学习框架。该模型不依赖次优的分子扰动，而是使用模态掩蔽来利用分子结构、细胞表型、结合亲和力、ADMET 图谱、量子化学模拟及其他药物发现数据中的信息。我们在多种基准上表明，Mol-JEPA 学得的表征具有强劲性能，显示出通过潜在空间预测纳入生化语境的价值。
items.author_line: Florian Rottach, Sebastian Schieferdecker, William Rudman, Randall Balestriero, Carsten Eickhoff

items.title: PHASE: encoding global protein ensembles with local Hamiltonians and all-atom backmapping
items.abstract_or_text: Protein function is governed by conformational ensembles, which can be viewed as high-dimensional probability distributions over molecular conformations. Yet the statistical organization of these distributions is often represented only implicitly, either through collections of simulation trajectories or within high-capacity generative models. Here, we introduce PHASE (Protein Hamiltonians for Sampling of Ensembles), a system-specific framework that converts atomistic conformational ensembles into an explicit and interpretable statistical model. Applied to ten conformational ensembles derived from approximately 37μs of atomistic simulations of the adenosine A2A receptor, Hamiltonians containing only local residue couplings within 6A reproduce residue-wise and pairwise microstate statistics, including correlations between residues that are not directly coupled in the model. Moreover, independently fitted inactive and active reference Hamiltonians define an endpoint preference coordinate that organizes newly sampled ligand-, effector- and conformation-dependent ensembles along the A2A activation landscape without receiving these biochemical labels as model inputs. Finally, a cluster-conditioned all-atom reconstruction model preserves the prescribed residue microstate patterns of newly sampled configurations, closing the coarse-graining-sampling-backmapping cycle. The resulting discrete representation additionally admits direct QUBO encoding, enabling classical annealing and providing a route toward future quantum-annealing implementations. PHASE therefore provides a protein-general procedure for constructing compact, interpretable and atomistically realizable statistical models of protein conformational ensembles.
items.summary_zh: PHASE 将原子级蛋白构象集合压缩为可解释的局部 Hamiltonian 统计模型，并配合全原子回构，描述 adenosine A2A receptor 的活化构象景观。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将构象集合转化为显式、可采样的统计模型，有望帮助分析配体和效应物相关的蛋白动态，并可编码为 QUBO。结果集中于约 37μs 模拟的十个 A2A receptor 构象集合，蛋白普适性和实验对应性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质功能由构象集合决定，构象集合可视为分子构象上的高维概率分布。然而，这些分布的统计组织通常只被隐式表示，要么体现在模拟轨迹的集合中，要么体现在高容量生成模型中。本文提出 PHASE（Protein Hamiltonians for Sampling of Ensembles），这是一个体系特异性框架，可将原子级构象集合转换为显式且可解释的统计模型。该方法应用于来自 adenosine A2A receptor 约 37μs 原子级模拟的十个构象集合后发现，仅含 6A 范围内局部残基耦合的 Hamiltonian，即可再现逐残基和成对微观状态统计，包括模型中未直接耦合的残基之间的相关性。此外，独立拟合的失活和活化参考 Hamiltonian 定义了一个终点偏好坐标；在不接收这些生化标签作为模型输入的情况下，该坐标可沿 A2A 活化景观组织新采样的、依赖配体、效应物和构象的集合。最后，一个簇条件化全原子重构模型可保留新采样构型中指定的残基微观状态模式，完成粗粒化、采样和回构的循环。所得离散表征还允许直接 QUBO 编码，支持经典退火，并为未来量子退火实现提供路径。因此，PHASE 为构建紧凑、可解释且可在原子水平实现的蛋白构象集合统计模型提供了适用于蛋白质的一般方法。
items.author_line: Daniele Angioletti, Marco Nobile, Matteo Carli, Vittorio Limongelli

items.title: High-Content Screening Identifies Dithiocarbamates As A Class Of Chemicals That Disrupts TDP-43 Proteostasis
items.abstract_or_text: Transactive response DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) aggregation and loss of function are hallmark features of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) among other neurodegenerative diseases. Despite epidemiological evidence linking environmental exposures to neurodegeneration, few toxicants have been directly associated with neurodegeneration. Here, we performed a high-content imaging screen, using a library of over a thousand chemical compounds that are considered high risk for human exposure and identified 21 toxicants that drive TDP-43 aggregation. Among the top chemical hits, five belonged to the dithiocarbamate (DTC) class of thiol-reactive compounds including the agricultural pesticides thiram and ziram. Thiram directly promoted TDP-43 cysteine oxidation and intermolecular crosslinking, whereas ziram induced TDP-43 aggregation via zinc imbalance and enhanced oxidative stress, suggesting DTCs disrupt redox homeostasis. In primary neurons and human iPSC-derived neurons, DTCs led to TDP-43 aggregation and prominent splicing defects consistent with loss of TDP-43 function. In exposed zebrafish, DTCs impaired TDP-43 function and triggered widespread transcriptional changes reflected by perturbed stress response and metabolic signatures. By combining TDP-43 loss of function mutations with chemical exposures, we observed accelerated TDP-43 loss of function and chemical-induced aggregation, supporting a multiple hit mechanism driving TDP-43 dysfunction. Together, these findings identify DTCs, particularly those used as agricultural pesticides, as dominant modifiers of TDP-43 proteostasis and identify redox imbalance and zinc homeostasis as a central molecular mechanism linking toxicant exposure to TDP-43 proteinopathy.
items.summary_zh: 通过包含逾千种高人类暴露风险化合物的高内涵成像筛选，发现 21 种可诱导 TDP-43 聚集的毒物，并解析 dithiocarbamates 的氧化还原和锌稳态相关机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究在原代神经元、人 iPSC 来源神经元和斑马鱼中延伸验证，提供环境暴露与 TDP-43 proteinopathy 相联系的实验证据。其结论仍属预印本，暴露剂量的现实相关性及人与疾病因果联系需要进一步研究。
items.abstract_zh: Transactive response DNA-binding protein 43（TDP-43）的聚集和功能丧失，是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、额颞叶痴呆（FTD）及其他神经退行性疾病的标志性特征。尽管流行病学证据将环境暴露与神经退行性疾病联系起来，直接与神经退行性疾病相关联的毒物仍很少。本文采用高内涵成像筛选，使用一个包含逾千种被认为具有人类高暴露风险化合物的文库，鉴定出 21 种驱动 TDP-43 聚集的毒物。在排名靠前的化学命中物中，有五种属于 dithiocarbamate（DTC）类巯基反应性化合物，包括农业杀虫剂 thiram 和 ziram。Thiram 直接促进 TDP-43 半胱氨酸氧化和分子间交联，而 ziram 通过锌失衡和增强氧化应激诱导 TDP-43 聚集，表明 DTCs 会扰乱氧化还原稳态。在原代神经元和人 iPSC 来源神经元中，DTCs 导致 TDP-43 聚集以及与 TDP-43 功能丧失一致的显著剪接缺陷。在暴露的斑马鱼中，DTCs 损害 TDP-43 功能，并引发广泛转录变化，表现为应激反应和代谢特征受扰。通过将 TDP-43 功能丧失突变与化学暴露相结合，我们观察到加速的 TDP-43 功能丧失和化学物诱导的聚集，支持一种驱动 TDP-43 功能障碍的多重打击机制。总体而言，这些发现确定 DTCs，特别是用作农业杀虫剂的 DTCs，是 TDP-43 蛋白稳态的重要调节因子，并指出氧化还原失衡和锌稳态是将毒物暴露与 TDP-43 proteinopathy 联系起来的核心分子机制。
items.author_line: Fragola, G., Weeks, R. D., Wolter, J., Bryan, A. F., Kapfer, K. N., Tian, X., Necarsulmer, J. C., Evangelista, B. A., Bhat, V., Arooji, O. K., Beltran, A. S., Brennan, T. A., Niederhuber, M. J., Hepperla, A., Collins, L. B., Williams, T. I., Ezzell, A. J., Planchart, A., Cohen, T. J.

items.title: Sparse autoencoder features from InterPLM predict neuropeptide precursors among secreted proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Neuropeptides are a diverse class of short, secreted signaling molecules that regulate key physiological processes in animals. Despite their important biological roles and increasingly recognized therapeutic value, the discovery of new neuropeptides remains challenging, largely because their short length and high sequence heterogeneity limit the effectiveness of motif- and homology-based approaches. Here, we present a pipeline for neuropeptide precursor prediction that leverages sparse autoencoders (SAEs) from InterPLM to decode dense ESM-2 protein language model embeddings into sparse, disentangled features. We identify a small subset of features strongly associated with neuropeptide precursors that achieve high discriminative performance. A logistic regression classifier trained on this reduced feature set, accurately separates human neuropeptide and non-neuropeptide sequences. We then applied this classifier to important model organisms: mouse (Mus musculus), zebrafish (Danio rerio), nematode (Caenorhabditis elegans), and fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster ) and show that the approach generalizes across diverse species. Overall, InterPLM SAE features provide an interpretable and effective strategy for neuropeptide prediction and enable a trained classifier to predict neuropeptides from large datasets. A web tool for this classifier is freely available at https://biolib.com/ATGCACTGTTCAGGCCTC/SAE Neuropeptide-Predictor
items.summary_zh: 利用 InterPLM 的稀疏自编码器特征解码 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型嵌入，并以精简特征集预测分泌蛋白中的神经肽前体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法将可解释表示学习用于难以由序列基序或同源性识别的短肽先导发现，并报告在人、小鼠、斑马鱼、秀丽隐杆线虫和果蝇中的泛化。摘要未说明候选神经肽的实验确认，跨物种结果仍主要是计算预测。
items.abstract_zh: 神经肽是一类多样化的短分泌信号分子，调控动物中的关键生理过程。尽管其具有重要生物学作用和日益受到重视的治疗价值，发现新的神经肽仍具挑战性，主要因为其长度短且序列异质性高，限制了基于基序和同源性的方法的有效性。本文提出一条神经肽前体预测流程，利用 InterPLM 的稀疏自编码器（SAEs），将稠密的 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型嵌入解码为稀疏、解耦的特征。我们识别出一小部分与神经肽前体强相关的特征，具有很高的判别性能。一个在该缩减特征集上训练的逻辑回归分类器，能够准确区分人神经肽和非神经肽序列。随后，我们将该分类器应用于重要模式生物：小鼠（Mus musculus）、斑马鱼（Danio rerio）、秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）和果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster），并表明该方法可泛化至多样物种。总体而言，InterPLM SAE 特征为神经肽预测提供了一种可解释且有效的策略，并使训练后的分类器能够从大型数据集中预测神经肽。该分类器的网页工具可免费使用，地址为 https://biolib.com/ATGCACTGTTCAGGCCTC/SAE Neuropeptide-Predictor。
items.author_line: Kulikova, A. V., Bookout, A. L., Koch, T. L., Safavi-Hemami, H.

items.title: A Conditional Structure-Aware Generative Transformer for Multi-Objective Design of m1Ψ-Modified RNA 5' UTRs
items.abstract_or_text: The 5' untranslated region is a major determinant of translation initiation, and its effect becomes especially important in modified mRNA sequences, where start-codon context, cap-proximal secondary structure, upstream AUGs and upstream open reading frames, and nucleotide chemistry can alter ribosome scanning and initiation recruitment, scanning, and decoding in sequence-dependent ways. Recent computational studies have moved the field from prediction toward design, including massively trained predictive models such as Smart5UTR for m1Ψ-modified mRNA, broader 5' UTR generation and optimization frameworks such as UTRGAN and UTailoR, and structure-guided RNA design systems such as RhoDesign. Here, we describe a conditional generative framework for 50-nt modified-RNA 5' UTR design that optionally conditions on ribosome load, GC content, minimum free energy, and target secondary structure. The implementation uses a Transformer-based generator followed by sequence ranking and local refinement with a Smart5UTR-derived ribosome-load oracle and ViennaRNA-based folding metrics, including support for modified-base folding parameters. Across multiple simulation scenarios and experimental settings, different combinations of RL, GC, MFE, and structural constraints produced distinct performance tradeoffs, enabling ablation-based identification of the best-performing formulation.
items.summary_zh: 构建可条件化的 Transformer，结合 Smart5UTR 衍生的核糖体负载 oracle 和 ViennaRNA 折叠指标，为 m1Ψ 修饰 RNA 5' UTR 开展多目标生成、排序和局部优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法同时处理翻译相关、组成和结构约束，契合修饰 mRNA 序列设计。摘要未给出实验规模、效应量或与现有设计器的直接比较，实际收益仍须由独立实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: 5' 非翻译区是翻译起始的主要决定因素，在修饰 mRNA 序列中其作用尤为重要；其中，起始密码子语境、帽端邻近二级结构、上游 AUG 和上游开放阅读框，以及核苷酸化学性质，都能以序列依赖方式改变核糖体扫描、起始募集、扫描和解码。近期计算研究已推动该领域从预测走向设计，其中包括针对 m1Ψ 修饰 mRNA 的大规模训练预测模型 Smart5UTR、更广泛的 5' UTR 生成和优化框架 UTRGAN 与 UTailoR，以及结构引导的 RNA 设计系统 RhoDesign。本文描述了一个用于 50-nt 修饰 RNA 5' UTR 设计的条件生成框架，可选择性地以核糖体负载、GC 含量、最小自由能和目标二级结构为条件。该实现使用一个基于 Transformer 的生成器，随后利用 Smart5UTR 衍生的核糖体负载 oracle 与基于 ViennaRNA 的折叠指标进行序列排序和局部优化，其中包括对修饰碱基折叠参数的支持。在多个模拟情景和实验设置中，RL、GC、MFE 和结构约束的不同组合产生了不同的性能权衡，从而能够通过消融分析识别表现最佳的方案。
items.author_line: Narges Zarnaghinaghsh, Ahmadreza Mofayezi, Byung-Jun Yoon

items.title: Molecular LLM Agents: From Architectural Design to Scientific Autonomy
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular science represents an important frontier for LLM-based agents. Unlike general agents that mainly operate over natural language, code, or web environments, molecular LLM agents must perceive, reason about, and act upon chemical objects across symbolic strings, molecular graphs, 3D conformations, spectra, simulations, and wet-lab measurements. Their capabilities depend on chemically faithful molecular perception, an LLM-centered agent framework, domain-specific tool grounding, and computational or experimental feedback, in addition to planning and tool use. This work develops a conceptual framework for molecular LLM agents from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce an architectural view of molecular-agent design, covering molecular representation and perception, the agent framework, domain-specific toolboxes, and learning and optimization. Second, we propose a scientific autonomy ladder inspired by staged autonomy in engineering systems, categorizing agents into four levels: L1 assistive or fixed workflows, L2 adaptive computational agents, L3 feedback-aware physical experiment agents, and L4 scientific-agenda agents. Together, these two perspectives establish a comprehensive framework for comparing existing molecular LLM agents, identifying missing capabilities and deployment risks, and guiding the design, evaluation, and deployment of future agents in molecular discovery workflows.
items.summary_zh: 提出分子 LLM agent 的架构视角和四级科学自主性阶梯，覆盖分子表征、工具接地、反馈以及计算和湿实验工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架为比较分子智能体的能力、识别缺失能力和部署风险提供共同语言。其核心贡献是概念性分类与设计框架，摘要未呈现统一基准、系统比较或新的闭环实验数据。
items.abstract_zh: 分子科学是基于 LLM 的 agents 的一个重要前沿。不同于主要在自然语言、代码或网页环境中运行的通用 agents，分子 LLM agents 必须跨符号字符串、分子图、3D 构象、光谱、模拟和湿实验测量来感知、推理并作用于化学对象。除规划和工具使用外，其能力还取决于化学保真的分子感知、以 LLM 为中心的 agent 框架、领域特异的工具接地，以及计算或实验反馈。本文从两个互补视角发展分子 LLM agents 的概念框架。首先，我们引入分子 agent 设计的架构视角，涵盖分子表示和感知、agent 框架、领域特异工具箱以及学习和优化。其次，我们提出受工程系统阶段性自主性启发的科学自主性阶梯，将 agents 分为四个等级：L1 辅助型或固定工作流，L2 自适应计算 agents，L3 具备反馈感知的物理实验 agents，以及 L4 科学议程 agents。这两个视角共同建立了一个综合框架，用于比较现有分子 LLM agents、识别缺失能力和部署风险，并指导未来分子发现工作流中 agents 的设计、评估和部署。
items.author_line: Jiatong Li, Wengyu Zhang, Weida Wang, Yuxuan Ren, Wei Liu, Chenyang Mao, Yuqiang Li, Yatao Bian, Changmeng Zheng, Xiaoyong Wei, Qing Li

breaking_news.headline_zh: Microsoft Research 发布 Skala 1.1 深度学习泛函
breaking_news.summary_zh: Microsoft Research 在官方帖文中发布 Skala 1.1 深度学习交换—相关泛函，称其提升预测准确性、扩展计算化学软件生态可用性，并提供持续更新的性能基准。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 交换—相关泛函决定 DFT 在材料和分子模拟中的精度与适用范围；可部署实现与公开基准会影响机器学习方法进入计算化学实践的速度。
